children: Following years of proven success with a top-three U.S. life insurer, ID Dataweb will now expand the use of Trust Stamp’s proprietary IT2 tokenization technology across its existing and prospective customer base
, a global provider of AI-powered identity and privacy-enhancing technologies, today announced a major expansion of its strategic partnership with

, a recognized leader in identity threat detection and risk mitigation. Building on three years of joint success serving one of the three largest life insurance providers in the United States, ID Dataweb will expand its use Trust Stamp’s biometric tokenization and identity fraud mitigation capabilities across its growing enterprise customer base.

The expanded relationship builds on a proven enterprise deployment and creates a scalable path for broader adoption of Trust Stamp’s technology through ID Dataweb. Trust Stamp’s patented Irreversibly Transformed Identity Token (IT2) technology transforms sensitive biometric data into secure, revocable identity tokens, helping organizations reduce the risks associated with storing biometric data while supporting privacy-conscious identity verification and fraud mitigation.

Trust Stamp President Andrew Gowasack commented, “Our long-standing work with ID Dataweb and a leading U.S. life insurance provider has demonstrated the technical and operational value of our technology in a demanding enterprise environment. Expanding our relationship with ID Dataweb represents an important next step in our commercial growth strategy and creates an opportunity to bring our IT2 technology to a broader range of enterprise customers. By combining Trust Stamp’s privacy-preserving tokenization capabilities with ID Dataweb’s identity threat detection platform and established enterprise reach, we can help more organizations strengthen identity trust while reducing the risks associated with sensitive biometric data.”

“Our relationship with Trust Stamp demonstrates the value of bringing together innovative, privacy-preserving technologies to solve real-world identity challenges,” said Matt Cochran, Chief Operating Officer at ID Dataweb. “After three years of successfully deploying Trust Stamp’s technology in a demanding enterprise environment, we see a significant opportunity to extend these capabilities to a broader set of customers. By integrating Trust Stamp’s biometric tokenization technology into the ID Dataweb platform, we can give organizations another powerful tool to establish identity trust, mitigate identity threats, and protect sensitive biometric information without introducing unnecessary friction into the customer experience.”

Trust Stamp is a global provider of AI-powered services for use in multiple sectors including banking and finance, regulatory compliance, government, healthcare, real estate, communications, and humanitarian services. Its technology empowers organizations via advanced solutions that reduce fraud, tokenize and secure assets and data, and securely authenticate users while protecting personal privacy, reducing friction in digital transactions, and increasing operational efficiency. With team members from over twenty nationalities in ten countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, Trust Stamp trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market

ID Dataweb™ helps enterprises stay ahead of identity fraud and account-related threats with real-time detection and mitigation while maintaining a seamless experience for their workforce, third parties, and customers. The ID Dataweb SaaS platform combines adaptive identity verification methods, behavioral analytics, device and credential intelligence, and risk scoring. Backed by AI and expert insights, these capabilities proactively stop identity-based attacks, protect revenue, and strengthen compliance. Unlike static legacy identity tools, ID Dataweb delivers dynamic, multi-layered risk orchestration that adapts to evolving threats. Its low-code, cloud-native services deploy quickly, integrate seamlessly with existing IAM systems, and align with each customer’s policies.

ID Dataweb originated from the National Strategy for Trusted Identities in Cyberspace (NSTIC) initiative in 2011, which aimed to establish a user-centric digital ecosystem based on secure, privacy-preserving, and interoperable credentials rather than usernames and passwords. ID Dataweb’s founders brought this vision to market as a leading private-sector enabler of NSTIC. Today, ID Dataweb is a trusted partner to Fortune 1000 companies processing hundreds of millions transactions. Many leading identity security providers such as RSA, Ping Identity, CyberArk (now part of Palo Alto Networks), Okta, Auth0, Saviynt, and SailPoint partner with ID Dataweb to embed the company’s technology into their solutions or ensure seamless interoperability. In a world where digital trust is the new currency, robust identity threat detection and risk mitigation is no longer just a security measure it is a business imperative.
